name: comp-371
title: Checkbox Dropdown Menu
description: A dropdown of checkbox options. Opening it reveals four named rows, any that are on show a tick at the right, and one row is disabled.
use: Several independent options must be toggled at once without leaving the menu, as with tag or column filters.
avoid: The trigger shows no summary of what is checked, so people must reopen it to see the current filters.
a11y: Real menu semantics and a properly disabled item are present, but the trigger never says which options are on. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark outlined button reading Checkbox items with a small chevron. Opened, a rounded dark menu lists Next.js, SvelteKit, Remix and Astro, each with a tick at its right when selected; Remix is dimmed.
behaves: Clicking the trigger opens a menu of four rows. Each row toggles a tick when picked, the menu stays open for more choices, and the disabled Remix row never responds.
customise: Option names and their starting ticks are fixed in the file, so changing the list means editing the source; the trigger label and button style come from shared pieces.
weight: light: A small menu with four rows and CSS state changes; no animation loop.
